title: Item Components Kinetic Weapon
description: Allows an item to deal kinetic damage and its effects. This happens every tick while in use, in a straight line along the user's view vector, with damage computed based on both the user's and the target's velocity projected onto the view vector (via a dot product). The more the user and target move toward each other, and the more this movement is aligned with the user's view vector, the higher the damage. After "damage_multiplier" and "damage_modifier" are applied, the resulting damage is floored to the nearest lower integer.

creative_reach.title: Creative Reach
creative_reach.description:
Defines the reach used when the user is in Creative Mode. Defaults to "reach" if unspecified.

Properties:
• max (float) = 0
• min (float) = 0

damage_conditions.title: Damage Conditions
damage_conditions.description:

• min_relative_speed (float) = 0

defaultSnippets.label: Item Components Kinetic Weapon Kinetic Effect Conditions

damage_modifier.title: Damage Modifier
damage_modifier.description: Value added to the the scaled dot product (after applying "damage_multiplier").

damage_multiplier.title: Damage Multiplier
damage_multiplier.description: Value multiplied to sum of the dot products of the user and target's velocity vectors projected onto the view vector.

delay.title: Delay
delay.description: Time, in ticks, after which kinetic damage and its effects start being applied.

dismount_conditions.title: Dismount Conditions
dismount_conditions.description:

• min_relative_speed (float) = 0
• min_speed (float) = 0

reach.title: Reach
reach.description:
Defines the range (in blocks) along the user's view vector where entities can be hit. Only targets within this distance are considered. Block collisions between the user and target block damage and its effects.

Properties:
• max (float) = 0
• min (float) = 0

max_duration.title: Max Duration
max_duration.description: Time, in ticks, during which the effect can be applied after "delay" elapses. If negative, the effect is applied indefinitely.

min_relative_speed.title: Min Relative Speed
min_relative_speed.description: Minimum relative speed of the user with respect to the target (projected onto the view vector via a dot product) required for the effect to be applied.

min_speed.title: Min Speed
min_speed.description: Minimum user's speed (projected onto the view vector via a dot product) required for the effect to be applied.
